launches.title: Prism: AI-Native Recruiting Agency
launches.tagline: Prism 🔍 AI-native recruiting agency The highest-scoring people search ever benchmarked, plugged into an agency that hands you hires ready to interview.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We're [Theo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/theokitsberg/) and [Axel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/axellapira/) — cofounders of [Prism](https://tryprism.com/).

**TL;DR**

Prism is an AI-native recruiting agency. You brief us on a Slack channel. We source, engage, and screen the candidates. You step in to interview and make the offer. You pay 15% of first-year salary when someone we find signs.

The engine underneath is the best people search in the world. We score 89.6 on the Public Sourcing Benchmark. This puts us 21+ points ahead of every published baseline and the benchmark was built and published by one of our direct competitors.

**Ask:** Hiring, or know someone who is? Reply here, DM, or grab a slot: <https://cal.com/theokitsberg/30mins>

❌ **The Problem**

Hiring is a company killer. Founders spend a third of their time on it. Bad hires cost more than missed quarters. Good hires change companies.

And yet the work itself is brutal. Inbound is 95% noise. Outbound competes with everyone else's outbound. Agencies are slow, expensive, and opaque. Software dumps thousands of half-relevant profiles on your desk and walks away.

The hardest part of hiring isn't picking the tool. It's doing the work.

🛠️ **Our Solution: an AI-native agency, built on the best people search in the world**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101452&key=user_uploads/2051069/8aca8a76-91fb-41f6-9312-59e3c9e7e2af)

**The best people search, independently verified.** 89.6 on the Public Sourcing Benchmark. 21+ points clear of the next system. The benchmark was built and published by Lessie, one of our direct competitors. The judge is Gemini, not us. The methodology was pre-registered and the queries and harness are public. Anyone can reproduce it. Read the full paper here: tryprism.com/papers/people-search-benchmark.pdf

**Calibration, not just keywords.** We extract the hidden hiring criteria buried in your JD and your past hires. A few thumbs-up / thumbs-down on early candidates and the search converges fast.

**Outreach that converts.** We engage candidates across LinkedIn, email, and WhatsApp, with messages calibrated to the role and the person.

**Scale agencies physically can't match.** We run dozens of searches in parallel today, every step instrumented. A traditional agency on a senior role has one human reading 20 profiles at a time. We read the whole web at once and use human time only where it actually matters.

**You brief us on Slack. We hand you a shortlist.** You handle the parts a founder should, which in our view are the interviews and the offer. Everything else is on us.

**Pricing:** $500 retainer to kick off a search. 15% of first-year salary when someone we find signs.

👬 **The Team**

**Theo (CEO)** — Cambridge dropout. Built and ran recruiting and training for a UK crisis helpline. Published research with MIT’s Media Lab.

**Axel (CTO)** — Oxford dropout. Previously founder associate at Alan, the French healthtech unicorn, where he worked on internal recruiting infra.

(+ an **amazing founding engineer** and **amazing in-house recruiter**, both hired with Prism!)

🙏 **Our Ask**

🔵 **Hiring?** Run a search with us. Reply, DM, or grab a slot: <https://cal.com/theokitsberg/30mins>

🔵 **Looking for your next role?** Meet Ray, our AI career advisor. One conversation and we'll match you with companies hiring people like you. Free [here](https://tryprism.com/?view=candidates), takes a few minutes

Thanks!

Theo & Axel
